title: Profile NFTs - Customizable NFT Webpage w/ user data on-chain in datums

ms.promise:
Profile NFTs are NFTs that you can currently mint on Cardano's preview network. You can level these NFTs up by completing actions on-chain. In this proposal we're going to give each of these NFTs a webpage that lives on Atrium.
For this milestone we'll output three different webpage mockup designs, and some early mockups of customization options in the webpages.
ms.criteria:
Acceptance Criteria:
・This milestone should be accepted given that we provide three different webpage mockups for Profiles NFTs.
・This milestone should also be accepted given that we provide some early mockups of customization options in the webpage.
ms.report:
Here is a link to:
・three different images that are mockups for the webpages.
・early mockups of customization options for the webpages.

Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1iF_efMDKx5jyVtgFrPiOnGSbVIfPjJHu?usp=sharing

ms.promise:
In this milestone we'll develop a Profile page for Staking Baskets. Staking Baskets are a smart-contract that lives in our platform. This smart-contract allows you to delegate to over 100 pools.

We're going to create a Profile page for this Staking Basket that shows Basket stats. These Basket stats will show total number of stakepools, how much ADA is in each stakepool, and how much ADA is in the Basket. Staking Baskets, and Profile NFTs will both have these web pages. The first Profile webpage for Staking Baskets will be live in our site.
ms.criteria:
Acceptance:
・Must build a Profile page for the first Staking Basket Diffusion.
・This Profile page must have stats from the first Staking Basket that's live on Cardano's preview network.
・Reviewers must be able to go to this page to review it given they setup a preview wallet.
・Must submit images of the page.

ms.promise:
Staking Baskets are a Cardano smart-contract that allows you to delegate to over 100 stakepools at the same time. Each Staking Basket will have a Profile page in the same way Profile NFTs have webpages.
In this milestone we'll output a Staking Basket Profile page directly in Atrium on Cardano's preview network. This webpage will have real blockchain stats that are being pulled live. This webpage will show how much ADA is in the Basket, how many SPOs are in the Basket, and what ADA % is being delegated to each SPO. Completing this milestone will help us integrate webpages for Profile NFTs in the next milestone.
ms.criteria:
This milestone should be accepted given that:
・We submit a link to our website where you can view this Staking Basket Profile page to see real stats from the Staking Basket.
・Staking Basket page must be live on Cardano's preview network.
・Staking Basket page must have real stats from Cardano's preview network, with real SPOs included.

ms.promise:
For the final milestone we'll ship Profile NFT webpages in the Atrium dashboard on Cardano's preview network. Anyone with a preview wallet will be able to come in, mint a Profile NFT, and have their own webpage. Users can customize will be able to customize their webpage by changing their NFT background. We'll also gather 25 real users to mint Profile NFTs, and provide feedback on their experience to find bugs.
Outputs:
・Final close-out report
・Final closeout video
・Profile NFT webpages with blockchain stats live on Atrium under alpha.atrium.io.
・25 feedback submissions from real users to solve bugs.
・Ability to customize Profile NFT webpage by changing Profile NFT background.
ms.criteria:
This milestone should be accepted given that:
・Final closeout report is publicly available
・Final closeout video is publicly available
・Reviewers, and regular users can mint Profile NFTs on Cardano's preview network to get their own webpage that lives in the Atrium dashboard.
・Profile NFT minters must be able to customize their webpage by changing their Profile NFT background.
・25 feedback forms need to be submitted from real users that minted Profile NFTs.
・Webpages must show stats from Cardano's preview network.
